Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is it from this enthralling contest! We have a double-header coming up on Saturday, 5th March. Bangladesh Women will take on South Africa Women in the first game of the day which begins at 3.30 am IST (10 pm GMT, previous night). The second game of the day sees a tussle between England Women and Australia Women. This mouth-watering clash will commence at 6.30 am IST (1 am GMT). Do join us then and make sure you tune in early for the buildup. Until then, take care and goodbye.

Stafanie Taylor, the skipper of West Indies Women, says that the way Matthews played, it changed the game for them. Tells that they spoke about getting 200 to be competitive and they got a good score on the board. On asked if Matthews will open regularly, she says that it is for the coaches to decide. Tells that they knew New Zealand Women are a good chasing team but they focused on their game and put up a good total which was crucial. Informs that Shakera Selman was supposed to bowl the last over but Deandra Dottin said she wanted to bowl the final over, so she just gave her the ball. Adds that they like to fly under the radar and do little by little and take one match at a time.

Sophie Devine, the skipper of New Zealand Women, says that it was an entertaining game but credits Matthews for the way she played. Tells that being the host nation they need to play their best cricket. Mentions that she is disappointed because she couldn't get her team over the line. Tells that they didn't start well with the ball but they will look to make amends against Bangladesh Women in their next game.

Hayley Matthews is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for her splendid all-round performance. She says that to get a win against the home side is unbelievable. Jokes that the players are telling her to get injured more often as the team won the game with her injured hamstring. Mentions that it was an important knock for her and they had to put a good performance. Says that this win means a lot to her and hopes that they carry the same momentum going forward.
... THE PRESENTATION ...

Well, in spite of dropping so many catches, West Indies Women have managed to get over the line but credit must go to them as they handled the pressure better than New Zealand Women in the end. They were very sloppy in the field but their bowlers fought till the end and held their nerves against a side that bats pretty deep. Hayley Matthews had a day out as she followed up her hundred in the first innings with a really good bowling spell and picked two crucial wickets. Anisa Mohammed also picked up a couple of wickets but it was the experienced Deandra Dottin who stole the show in the last over as she defended 5 runs in the last over and West Indies Women have started the tournament on a winning note.

New Zealand Women had their task cut out as they had to chase 260 runs but they were denied a good start as they lost Suzie Bates and Amelia Kerr early on in the innings. It was their skipper, Sophie Devine who carried on with her good form and steadied the ship along with Amy Satterthwaite. However, once the White Ferns lost Amy Satterthwaite, things went downhill for them as they lost wickets in a cluster. Devine held one end also notched up her sixth hundred in ODIs. She kept losing partners at the other end but had a good partnership with Katey Martin. Once Devine departed, it was Jess Kerr and Martin who took their side to safer shores but they failed to get 6 runs in the last over.

WOW! What a thrilling game to kick off the ICC Women's World Cup, 2022! West Indies Women looked down and out at one point but the experience of Deandra Dottin in the last over has done wonders for West Indies Women. New Zealand Women would be gutted as they had things under control for a majority of the innings but lost their way in the end overs.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh my word, what a humdinger of a contest. Deandra Dottin bowls a back-of-the-hand delivery, outside off, jagging back in a little. Hannah Rowe has a slash at it but fails to connect. Fran Jonas wants a bye and starts running but Hannah Rowe sends her back. Shemaine Campbelle collects the ball and under-arms it to Deandra Dottin who runs back and whips the bails off. Fran Jonas is well short of her crease. The players of West Indies Women are ecstatic. WEST INDIES WOMEN WIN BY 3 RUNS!
Fran Jonas is the last batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Deandra Dottin is bowling the over of her life! Exceptional bowling this! Deandra Dottin hasn't bowled a single over in this match and her skipper, Stafanie Taylor asks her to bowl the most important over and she is not disappointing her. Length ball, on middle. Jess Kerr backs away and lofts it towards mid off. Didn't time it that well and Chinelle Henry at mid off runs across to her left and grabs the catch over her head. 4 needed from 2 balls! West Indies Women need one wicket. New Zealand Women one hit away! Whose game will this be?
Commentary.Howout: c Chinelle Henry b Deandra Dottin

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller in length, on middle and leg. Hannah Rowe clears her front leg and drives it to mid on for a single. 4 needed from 3 balls! This still could be anyone's game!
Hannah Rowe walks out to bat.

OUT! LBW! Deandra Dottin runs in and bowls it full, on leg. Katey Martin tries to flick but misses and gets struck on the back pad. The players of West Indies put up a huge appeal and the umpire raises his finger. Katey Martin wants this to be reviewed. UltraEdge shows no bat involved. Ball Tracker shows three reds. The original decision stands. Deandra Dottin strikes and what a time to get the wicket. Katey Martin has played a handy knock for her side. A fighting knock comes to an end.

Review! Katey Martin has reviewed it straightaway after being adjudged LBW! Huge moment in this game. No bat involved, confirms the UltraEdge and the Ball Tracker indicates three reds and New Zealand Women lose a review.

Hits it hard! Length ball, on middle. Jess Kerr makes room and smashes it to wide of mid off. Chinelle Henry shows great committment by putting in a dive to her left. Saved a certain boundary. A single is taken!
Deandra Dottin to bowl the last over of the innings.

FOUR! Up and over! Terrific from Martin! Width on offer, outside off. Katey Martin accepts it with both hands. She latches onto it and cuts it over covers for another boundary. Chinelle Henry has her hands on her knees. She knows this was a poor delivery. 6 needed from 6 now!

FOUR! Martin gets the important boundary! Brute power on that one! Fuller in length, on middle. Katey Martin stands tall and whips it to deep mid-wicket. This was picked up brilliantly and gets the reward.
Slower ball, on off. Katey Martin launches it over mid off. Doesn't have enough legs to go all the way but still will get two runs.
Full and outside off, Kerr drives it to deep point for a single. West Indies Women won't mind these singles. New Zealand Women need a boundary badly!
Back of a length, outside off. Jess Kerr slaps it over covers. The batters run two.
Length ball, on off. Katey Martin comes down the pitch and swings. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man for a single.
Loopy ball, outside off. Jess Kerr cuts away but can't beat the point fielder again. Hayley Matthews finishes her spell. Her figures read 10-1-41-2. 20 needed from 12!
Short and on off, Jess Kerr backs away and cuts but finds the point fielder.
On middle, knocked back to the bowler.
FOUR! Jess Kerr is playing a superb knock here. Too short, outside off. Kerr skips down the track and slaps it over mid off for another boundary.
Flatter, full and on off. Jess Kerr drives hard but straight to the fielder at extra cover. A precious dot ball for West Indies Women.

PUT DOWN! Loopy ball, on middle. Jess Kerr advances down the track and heaves it to long on. The fielder there charges ahead but fails to grab it. Another catch spilled out by West Indies Women. These might hurt them.
Full and outside off, Kerr drills it down to long off for a run. 26 needed off 18!
On a good length, on off. Jess Kerr defends it out.
FOUR! Another boundary of Kerr's bat! Fuller in length, on off. Jess Kerr simply lifts it over mid off for a boundary. She is playing a handy knock here.
Length ball, outside off. Martin chops it towards covers for a single.
On a length, on off. Martin taps it to backward point. Crucial dot balls these!
Well bowled! Good-length delivery, outside off. Katey Martin is drawn forward and looks to drive. The ball zips past the outside edge.
A dot to end! Tosses it up, on middle. Jess Kerr prods and keeps it out. 32 needed from 24 balls.
Full and outside off, clipped to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floats it up, on off. Jess Kerr dabs it to the off side for another quick single.
FOUR! A boundary at the right time. Valuabe runs from the bat of Jess Kerr! Short and on middle, Jess Kerr makes room and places it nicely through covers for a boundary.
Dots won't help New Zealand Women's cause here. Full and on middle, pushed towards covers.
Loopy ball, on middle. Katey Martin turns it to square leg for a quick single.
Another ball, shorter in length, outside off. Katey Martin steers it towards third man and takes a single. 39 runs needed off 30 balls.
This is a good-length ball, outside off. Jess Kerr taps in front of square on the off side and takes a single.
Short of a length, outside off. Jess Kerr hangs back and cuts it behind square on the off side to collect a couple of runs.
Another ball, outside off. Jess Kerr looks for a booming drive but she misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Jess Kerr steers it past the keeper and comes back for the second run.
Jess Kerr is the new batter in.

Both the umpires gather and have taken this upstairs. They want to see if it was a clean catch. The soft signal is OUT. Replay rolls in and shows that Chinelle Henry has indeed taken the catch cleanly. Sophie Devine knew it already and has to walk back.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Well, it had to take something special to get rid of Sophie Devine and Chinelle Henry provides the breakthrough for her side. Huge moment in this game as the White Ferns' skipper walks back to the hut. Terrific reflexes from Henry and West Indies Women will breathe a sigh of relief! Coming to the ball - This was a length ball, around off. Sophie Devine prods and looks to push it back past the bowler but she ends up chipping it to the left of Henry. She moves there, sticks her left hand out, the ball pops out but she takes a juggling catch in the end. End of a brilliant innings from Devine though!
Short and wide, outside off. Sophie Devine slaps it through the cover region and takes a single.
Another ball, full and on middle. Katey Martin tucks it in front of square on the leg side and settles for a single.
A full toss, on middle. Sophie Devine drills it to long on for a run.
On a length, around middle. Sophie Devine defends it off the back foot.
A full ball, outside off. Katey Martin looks to drive but it goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a run.
FOUR LEG BYES! Handy runs for New Zealand Women! A length ball, angling down leg. Katey Martin misses her flick and the ball brushes her pad before going past the keeper and into the fine leg fence.
A full toss, on middle. Katey Martin drags it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single. 53 runs needed off 42 balls.
Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine slaps it through covers and hands the strike back to Martin.
Short and wide, outside off. Katey Martin cuts it behind square on the off side and settles for a run.
On a length, around off. Sophie Devine drives it to long off for a single.
Good effort from the fielder in the deep! Short of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it uppishly past the point fielder and takes a couple of runs as the fielder in the deep cuts it off.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Katey Martin pushes it through the off side and rotates the strike.
On a length, outside off. Devine punches it towards the extra cover fielder. 60 runs needed off 48 balls.
Short of a length, around off. Katey Martin taps it to the off side and takes a single. 200 comes up for New Zealand Women.
A full ball, on the pads. Katey Martin misses her flick and gets hit low on her pad.
A full ball, on middle. Katey Martin pushes it back to the bowler. Aaliyah Alleyne half-stops it and the ball deflects onto the stumps. Sophie Devine does well to get back in time.
A length ball, around off. Katey Martin gets behind the line of the ball to defend it.
Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine rocks back and cuts it to deep cover for one run.
This is a length ball, around off. Katey Martin taps it towards cover.
Good-length delivery, around off. Sophie Devine pushes it towards cover and rotates the strike.
On a length, outside off. Katey Martin cuts it past the point fielder and takes a run.
DROPPED! Back of a length, outside off. Katey Martin cuts hard towards Deandra Dottin at backward point but she fails to grab it cleanly. Another chance goes abegging!

On a length, around off. Sophie Devine pushes it through the off side and takes a run. Devine gets to her HUNDRED and this is her sixth in ODIs. Brilliant innings from her but the skipper would be aware that the job is only half done and she would be eager to bat till the end now.
Back of a length, outside off. Katey Martin steers it towards third man for a single.
End of Powerplay 2! West Indies Women can now have a maximum of 5 fielders outside the ring till the 50th over.
Another poor delivery! A full toss, on middle. Katey Martin sweeps it behind square on the leg side for a single. 66 needed from 60 balls!
FOUR! Way too short, outside off. Katey Martin waits for it and hammers it through extra cover for a boundary.
Drifting down leg, Martin sweeps but straight to short fine leg.
Devine moves to 99! A full toss, on middle. Sophie Devine swipes it to deep square leg for a single.
Tosses it up, outside off. Martin nudges it to square leg for a run.
Two! Full and on off, Katey Martin gets behind and whips it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Tossed up, outside off. Martin works it on the leg side gently for a single.
Short and outside off, Katey Martin goes for the cut shot but mistimes it towards covers.
FOUR! Lovely shot! A juicy full toss, outside off. Katey Martin whacks it through extra cover. Finds the gap and the ball races away to the ropes.
Katey Martin shimmies down the track and gets to the pitch of the ball but mistimes her shot and gets hit on the pads.
Loopy ball, outside off. Katey Martin first looks to sweep but then drives it towards covers.
Short and wide, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it through covers for a single.
Tosses up, outside off. Sophie Devine slog-sweeps it to deep square leg. The fielder this time does well and keeps it to a single.
Slower, outside off. Devine defends it back.

MISFIELD AND FOUR! A much-needed boundary for New Zealand Women! Floats it up, on middle. Sophie Devine gets down on one knee and sweeps it straight to deep square leg. The fielder there misfield and lets it through her hands for a boundary. Dropped catches and misfields can prove to be very costly here for West Indies Women!
Short and outside off, cut away to deep point for one.
Loopy ball, full and outside off. Sophie Devine drills that one to mid on for a single.
Full and on off, clipped to mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, Devine rocks back and knocks it back to the bowler. Excellent over from Hayley Matthews. Just two runs off it.
On the pads, swept to deep square leg for a single.
On off, dabbed to the off side.
That was so close! Loopy ball, turning back in, on middle. Katey Martin is cut in half as she tries to cut. The ball goes just over the stumps beating her inside edge.
Floats it up, outside off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Loopy ball, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it hard to deep point for a run.
Shortish, outside off. Devine stays back and cuts it through covers for a single. 91 needed from 84 balls.
Flighted delivery, on off. Martin works it past mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Martin drives it to mid on.
Slower through the air, outside off. Katey Martin paddles it to fine leg for a brace.
Loopy ball, outside off. Martin pushes it towards covers.
Short and on middle, Devine pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up, outside off. Katey Martin gets forward and blocks it out.
Deft touch! Flatter ball, on off. Katey Martin hangs back and guides it through the third man region for a brace. She is off the mark!
Katey Martin walks out to bat now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Excellent field placement from Stafanie Taylor and Hayley Matthews gets another wicket! The ploy to keep a slip in place for the new batter has done wonders for West Indies Women! Matthews serves a loopy ball, on a length outside off. Brooke Halliday hangs back and looks to guide it through the third man region but she ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes straight to Anisa Mohammed at first slip and she does well to grab the ball. West Indies Women are on top now!
Commentary.Howout: c Anisa Mohammed b Hayley Matthews

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and around off. Sophie Devine eases it to long on for a single.
Slower through the air, on a length, around middle. Brooke Halliday gets low and pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and on off. Brooke Halliday taps it towards cover but not in the gap.

A better throw at the striker's end and it could have been curtains for Sophie Devine! This is a length ball, on off. Brooke Halliday taps it towards backward point and takes off for a single. The throw from the backward point fielder is a bit wayward and Devine manages to get in safely.
Fuller in length, on middle. Sophie Devine works it to long on for a single.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Brooke Halliday taps it towards cover and scampers through to the other end.
Tosses it up, around off. Brooke Halliday defends it to the off side.
On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine pushes it to the off side for a run.
FOUR! CUT AWAY! Shorter in length, outside off. Sophie Devine hangs back and cuts it past point for a boundary. 3000 runs in ODIs for Sophie Devine!
Back of a length, around off. Brooke Halliday defends it to the off side.
Brooke Halliday is the new batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! Stafanie Taylor makes no mistake this time and West Indies Women get another wicket. This is a length ball, angling in from off. Green skips down and looks to heave it away but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards Stafanie Taylor at mid-wicket who takes a simple catch. New Zealand Women are in a bit of a trouble now!
Commentary.Howout: c Stafanie Taylor b Shakera Selman

Commentary.Commentary: This is a length ball, around off. Maddy Green gets solid in her front foot defence.
On a length, angling into the batter. Sophie Devine only manages to tuck it towards mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Good-length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine prods to drive but she fails to get any bat on it.
FOUR! Nicely played! Back of a length, around middle and leg. Sophie Devine pulls it behind square on the leg side and bags a boundary.
On a length, around middle. Maddy Green keeps it out.
This is a loopy ball, on middle. Sophie Devine looks to sweep but she gets a top edge and luckily for her, it lands safely. A single taken.
A bit quicker through the air, outside off. Maddy Green pushes it to the off side for a run.
FOUR! WHACKED! Flatter and quicker, around off. Maddy Green rocks back and slaps it through the cover region for a boundary.
On a length, outside off. Maddy Green looks to cut but it goes off the underedge and onto the deck.

DROPPED! Another one put down! This is tossed up, around middle. Sophie Devine looks to sweep but it goes off the top edge, in the air towards deep square leg where the fielder makes a mess of it. The batters take a run.
Another single! A full ball, around off. Sophie Devine drills it back to the bowler who half-stops it and the batters cross ends.
On a length, around off. Maddy Green pushes it towards mid off and sets off for a quick run. Runs coming only in singles at the moment for New Zealand Women.
Another ball, full and around off. Sophie Devine drags it down to long on for a single.
Full and around leg. Maddy Green flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A length ball, around off. Maddy Green blocks it out from the crease.
Back of a length, on middle. Sophie Devine pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball, on off. Devine sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single. 125 needed from 120 balls.
Fraction short, on off. Green punches it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up, outside off. Eased down to lon on for a single.
Flatter ball, on middle. Sophie Devine makes room and cuts but to cover-point.
No hat-trick! Short and outside off, Maddy Green cuts it past point for a run.
Maddy Green walks in at number 6.

OUT! TIMBER! Anisa Mohammed is making a name for herself here. Two wickets in quick succession for West Indies Women and they are on top at the moment. Anisa Mohammed bowls a loopy ball, on middle. Lea Tahuhu tries to work it on the leg side and plays down the wrong line. Misses it completely and the ball disturbs the wooden furniture behind her. New Zealand Women in a spot of bother now. Anisa Mohammed is on a hat-trick as well!
Full and straight, Lea Tahuhu slices it over covers for a single.
Full again, on off. Devine eases it down to long on for a run.
Right into the blockhole, on middle. Lea Tahuhu jams it out to mid on for a single.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball, on off. Lea Tahuhu smashes it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Good-length ball, on off. Lea Tahuhu stabs it towards covers.
Full and on off, Sophie Devine drives it to long off for a single.

DRINKS! West Indies Women have got the much-needed breakthrough but New Zealand Women would still feel comfortable as long as their skipper is out in the middle. The White Ferns bat pretty deep so West Indies Women will need to keep chipping with wickets here. Lea Tahuhu walks out to bat.

Review! Amy Satterthwaite has opted for a review after being adjudged LBW! Did she get any bat on it? No, she didn't, confirms the UltraEdge. The Ball Tracker rolls in and it indicates three reds. New Zealand Women lose a review.

OUT! LBW! Four dot balls and Amy Satterthwaite tries to release the pressure. Anisa Mohammed bowls a loopy ball, full and straight, Amy Satterthwaite looks to work it on the leg side but gets pinged on the front pad. The players appeal and the umpire agrees straightaway. Amy Satterthwaite has a word with Sophie Devine and decides to challenge the umpire. Nothing on UltraEdge and the Ball Tracker shows that the ball is pitching in line, the impact is in line and it is wickets hitting. Three reds and Amy Satterthwaite has to walk back to the pavilion. Anisa Mohammed breaks the 76-run stand and has got a wicket at an important time for her side.
Tossed up, on off. Amy Satterthwaite keeps it out.
Short and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite pulls but finds mid-wicket.
Slower ball, on off. Amy Satterthwaite Pushed back to the bowler again.
Loopy ball, on off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Good running! Short and on leg, Amy Satterthwaite skips down the track and whips it to deep mid-wicket. She pushes hard for the second run and gets it easily.
Length ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite mistimes her drive to cover for a single.
On the pads, Sophie Devine glances it to mid-wicket. Stafanie Taylor picks up the ball and has an aim at the bowler's end but misses by a whisker. Had that hit, Sophie Devine was out by a long mile.
Good-length ball, around off. Devine knocks it back to the bowler.
On a length, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite works it off the pads to deep square leg. She crosses ends.
Fuller, on off. Devine drills it to long on for one.
Length ball, outside off. Devine cuts it very hard but straight to point.
Full and on leg, Amy Satterthwaite steps out and works it to mid on.
A low full toss, on middle. Sophie Devine sweeps it to deep square leg and rotates the strike.
Uppish but safe! Touch fuller, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it uppishly over mid-wicket for a single.
On a length, on off. Amy Satterthwaite dabs it to backward point.
Slower ball, full and around off. Pushed back to the bowler.
Length ball, on off. Sophie Devine slaps it to deep extra cover for a single.
A slower ball, on a length, around middle. Sophie Devine eases it to long on for a single. 146 runs needed off 150 balls.
A full ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite jams it out towards cover and manages only a single. Stafanie Taylor there, dives to her right and keeps it to just one.
Short of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine slaps it through the cover region and rotates the strike.
Another ball, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drags it towards extra cover and takes a run.
Wide! Amy Satterthwaite skips down so Shakera Selman serves a full ball, way outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cannot get towards it and the umpire signals wide. Free Hit to continue.
No ball! A full ball, on off. Sophie Devine gets forward and works it to long off for a single. Shakera Selman oversteps and the umpire calls it a no ball. Free Hit to follow.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to the off side and rotates the strike.
Back of a length, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite nudges it towards cover.
Flatter ball, on off. Sophie Devine tucks it to the off side for a run.

DROPPED! Amy Satterthwaite GETS A LIFE! A short ball, on leg. Amy Satterthwaite miscues her pull shot towards the deep square leg fielder who runs in to take the catch but she spills it and the batters take a run.
A loopy ball, full and on middle. Amy Satterthwaite digs it out.
Flatter and quicker, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it to deep cover for a run.
FOUR! Anisa Mohammed serves a full ball, down leg. Sophie Devine kneels and nails her sweep behind square on the leg side for a boundary.

Looks like Shamilia Connell has hurt herself on her leg. The physio comes running in to have a look. She is limping and is walking off the field now. Hope, it will be not be a big injury blow to West Indies Women. Cherry-Ann Fraser comes in to replace her in the field.
Flatter ball, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite punches it towards the extra cover fielder who fumbles and the batters take a single. 100 comes up for New Zealand Women!
Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine looks to cut but she gets an underedge and the ball dabs onto the deck.
A full ball, on middle. Sophie Devine drives it back past the bowler towards long on and the batters take two runs.
Good-length ball, on middle. Sophie Devine tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Another ball, full and outside off. Sophie Devine looks to drive but it goes off the inner half of the blade towards mid-wicket.
Back of a length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite mistimes her cut shot towards point and the batters cross ends.
A full ball, on middle. Sophie Devine works it to long on for a run.
Flatter ball, on a length and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it wide of deep cover and takes a couple of runs.
An overpitched ball, around middle. Amy Satterthwaite digs it out back to the bowler.
Looped up, on a length, around middle. Amy Satterthwaite keeps it out.
Another ball, on a length, outside off. Devine cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Sophie Devine stays back to cut but she misses.
FOUR! BANG! Sophie Devine gets to her FIFTY in style! A gift from Anisa Mohammed, a half-tracker, on middle. Devine rocks back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket to collect a boundary.
Change from both ends! Anisa Mohammed comes into the attack now.
Full and outside off. Sophie Devine drills it to long off and retains the strike by taking a run. 172 runs needed off 174 balls.
Short of a length, around off. Sophie Devine hangs back and taps it towards backward point. No run there!
This is on a length, around off. Sophie Devine blocks it onto the deck.
A length ball, around off. Amy Satterthwaite taps it wide of cover and takes an easy single.
A slower ball, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it to the fielder at extra cover.
Good-length ball, around off. Sophie Devine bunts it towards extra cover and rotates the strike.
Shakera Selman comes into the attack.
Very full and straight, Amy Satterthwaite comes forward and jams it out to mid on.
Too full and on off, Sophie Devine drops it to the off side for a quick single.
On off, Amy Satterthwaite turns it to the off side for a sharp single.
Loopy ball, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it uppishly to deep mid-wicket for a brace.
Flighted ball, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it through covers for one.
On the pads, worked to square leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Sophie Devine blocks it out.
WIDE! More pressure on Alleyne! Sprays this one down the leg side. Wided.
FOUR! This will hurt West Indies Women more now! Aaliyah Alleyne overpitches it on middle, Sophie Devine drills it back past her to long on for a boundary.
On middle and leg, kept out.

DROPPED! Big moment in the game! How costly will this prove to be? Sophie Devine just tries to break the shackles and looks to go over mid on. Doesn't time this length ball well and ends by smacking it straight to the fielder at mid on where Shemaine Campbelle puts it down. The ball rolls past her and the batters run two.
Full and outside off, Amy Satterthwaite carves it through covers for a single.

Fuller in length, on middle. Sophie Devine jams it out to mid off. She sets off for a single but Amy Satterthwaite is caught ball-watching. The keeper asks the fielder to throw the ball to her end but the batter makes it home in time.
Full and on middle, nudged to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, dabbed to point. The fielder there misfields and allows a single.
Quicker delivery, coming in with the arm, on leg. Sophie Devine wrists it to mid-wicket.
This time Amy Satterthwaite gets her sweep right and plays it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Oh, that was close! Tosses it up nicely, around off, turning away. Amy Satterthwaite sits down on one knee and looks to sweep but misses. The ball was centimetres away from hitting the off pole.
Short and on off, Sophie Devine makes room and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! A welcome boundary! Length ball, on the pads, the ball stays a touch low. Amy Satterthwaite does well to whip it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Slower ball, full and outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to mid off.
Full and on off. Amy Satterthwaite defends it towards covers.
Full and on leg, Devine misses her flick once again. Gets hit on the pads and the ball rolls to square leg for a leg bye.
Fuller in length, on off. Devine mistimes her drive to the off side.
On a length, on leg. Sophie Devine misses her flick and gets hit on the pads. Half-hearted appeal for an lbw but that was going down leg.
Can't get it through! On off, Amy Satterthwaite sits back and punches it towards covers. A maiden from Hayley Matthews!
Floats it up, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to point. She is struggling to rotate the strike here.
Slower through the air, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite pushes it to mid off.
Full and on off, blocked out by Amy Satterthwaite to point.
Loopy ball, on middle. Pushed back to the bowler.
Tosses it up, on middle, turning away. Amy Satterthwaite looks to defend but it goes off the outside edge to cover.

Drinks! West Indies Women are doing well here by bowling tight and not allowing the batters to settle. They have also got the key wickets of Suzie Bates and Amelia Kerr. New Zealand Women now need a big partnership and would rely on their captain and on their vice captain to provide one.
This is on a length, around off. Sophie Devine punches it towards mid off. A dot to end the over.
Back of a length, around off. Sophie Devine defends it towards backward point.
Drop and run! A length ball, around off. Amy Satterthwaite taps it towards point and sets off for a single.
A full ball, around off. Amy Satterthwaite drives it back to the bowler.
On a length, around off. Sophie Devine taps it to the off side and collects a run.
Good-length delivery, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite slaps it through covers and hands the strike back to her skipper.
A full toss, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Tossed up, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite leand and keeps it out.
Slower through the air, well outside off. Amy Satterthwaite looks to sweep but she misses.
Flatter and quicker, on off. Sophie Devine flat-bats it to long on for a run.
Floated, on a length, around off. Amy Satterthwaite kneels and sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up, around off. Amy Satterthwaite blocks it off the front foot.
FOUR! SMASHED! Top shot from the skipper! Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it through the cover region and collects a boundary.
Play and a miss! Shorter in length, outside off. Sophie Devine looks to cut hard but she misses.
Another ball, on a length, outside off. Sophie Devine punches it towards point but the fielder there does well to stop it with a dive.
Short of a length, just outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A length ball, angling across the batter. Amy Satterthwaite reaches out to cut but she fails to get any bat on it.
Wide! Full and wide, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite leaves it alone. Wided!
Back of a length, around off. Amy Satterthwaite dabs it onto the deck.
Shorter in length, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite cuts it to deep cover for a single.
On a length, around off. Sophie Devine pulls it without much timing towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter ball, on middle. Amy Satterthwaite tucks it to the leg side for a run.
Tossed up, outside off. Amy Satterthwaite looks to defend but the ball beats her outside edge.
Amy Satterthwaite is the new batter in.

OUT! LBW! Yes, she has worked her magic with the ball as well! Hayley Matthews strikes straightaway and she gets the prized scalp of Amelia Kerr! This is a flatter ball, around off that turns in late. Kerr stays on the back foot to flick but she misses and gets pinged on her pad. Matthews appeals and the umpire raises his finger. Huge moment in this game as the in-form Amelia Kerr walks back to the hut.
Hayley Matthews is brought into the attack now. Did her job with the bat, can she do it with the ball as well?
Flatter ball, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A low full toss, outside off. Sophie Devine looks to drive but it goes off the toe end towards mid-wicket for a single.
Full and around off. Sophie Devine drags it towards mid on.
FOUR! SMASHED! Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine hangs back and slaps it past the mid off fielder to bag a boundary.
Good-length delivery, around off. Sophie Devine keeps it out.
Back of a length, angling in from middle. Sophie Devine drags it towards mid-wicket but not in the gap.
On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it towards point.
End of Powerplay 1! West Indies Women can now have a maximum of 4 fielders outside the ring till the 40th over. Also, Aaliyah Alleyne comes into the attack.
Length ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr goes chasing after it but misses her cut.
FOUR! Well played! Slightly short, on middle. Amelia Kerr swivels and pulls it to behind square on the leg side for a boundary.
Into the blockhole, on middle. Kerr jams it out to mid-wicket.
On a length, outside off. Devine guides it with soft hands to third man for a run.
Good-length ball, outside off. Devine punches it off the back foot to cover.
Fuller, on off. Driven to mid off.
On a length, around off. Amelia Kerr taps it towards backward point. Five dots in a row.
A short ball, on middle. Amelia Kerr looks to pull but she fails to get any bat on it.
Short and wide, outside off. Amelia Kerr slashes hard but she misses.
Back of a length, outside off. Amelia Kerr cuts it towards point.

NOT OUT! Good-length ball, around off. Amelia Kerr looks to punch but gets a faint feather on it. The ball goes through to the keeper but dies on the way. However, West Indies Women appeal for a caught behind. The umpires take it upstairs and the soft signal is not out. Replay shows that the ball bounces in front of the keeper before she collected it.
A referral has been sent upstairs for caught behind. The soft signal is NOT OUT. Yes, the ball has clearly bounced before going to the keeper. Kerr survives.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Length ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr hangs back and cuts it past the outstretched arms of Deandra Dottin at backward point for a boundary.
Back of a length, on off. Sophie Devine stands tall and knocks it back to the bowler. Just the wide off the over!
WIDE! This time the ball is pushed a bit wider and Devine lets it sail through. Wide given.
Outside off, just inside the tramline. Sophie Devine leans but then decides to let it go.
On a good length, on off. Sophie Devine blocks it off the front foot towards covers.
Well bowled! Good-length ball, on middle. Sophie Devine covers the line and blocks it out.
Back of a length, on off. Devine punches it to cover.
Slower ball, full and outside off. Sophie Devine plays it straight to mid off. West Indies Women have done well so far to keep it tight and not allowing the batters to break free.
Touch fuller, on middle and leg. Amelia Kerr drives it to mid on.
Length ball, outside off. Amelia Kerr goes chasing after it and slashes but misses.
Full and outside off, Sophie Devine drives it to mid off for a quick single.
FOUR! Excellent shot! Short of a length, on middle. Sophie Devine picks it up and pulls it in the gap to deep mid-wicket to bag a boundary.
Short of a length, outside off. Devine keeps smashing it to the off side. This time cuts it to wide of point where Deandra Dottin moves to his right and stops the ball.
On a length, on off. Devine cuts it straight to point.
Touch fuller this time, outside off. Sophie Devine smashes it to the busy sweeper cover once again for another single.
Short of a length, on leg. Kerr swivel-pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Full again, on the pads. Kerr pushes it to mid on.
Fuller in length, on middle. Amelia Kerr drives it to mid on.
Good-length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine slashes hard to sweeper cover for just a run.
Fuller in length, on middle. Sophie Devine digs it out to point.
Short and wide, outside off. Sophie Devine stays back and cuts it to deep cover. A single to end the over.
A short ball, around off. Amelia Kerr hangs back and swivel-pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it to deep point and rotates the strike.
Fuller in length, outside off. Amelia Kerr looks to drive but it goes off the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Wide! Another ball, well outside off. Amelia Kerr does not bother to play at it. Wided!
BEATEN! Good-length delivery, outside off. Amelia Kerr has a poke at it but the ball beats her outside edge.
Length ball, pushed wider outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it away to point for a single.
Off the mark straightaway! Length ball, on middle and leg. Amelia Kerr wrists it through mid-wicket and picks up a brace.
Very full and on middle, Sophie Devine pushes it to mid on and she crosses ends.
Short of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine punches it to mid off.
Full and on off, Sophie Devine leans and pushes it to cover.
Amelia Kerr walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Oh, dear! That is one of the most unfortunate ways to get out. A big wicket nonetheless for West Indies Women! A full ball, around off. Sophie Devine drills it back towards the bowler. Chinelle Henry sticks her right hand out to stop the ball. The ball ricochets off her fingertips and goes on to shatter the stumps at the non-striker's end. Suzie Bates is backing up way too much and she is a goner! An early breakthrough for West Indies Women.
FOUR! First boundary of the innings! Chinelle Henry serves a full ball, on middle. Sophie Devine clears his front leg and heaves it over mid-wicket and bags a boundary.
Good-length ball, outside off. Sophie Devine slaps it through covers and collects a run.
On a length, nipping back in from middle. Suzie Bates looks to defend but it goes off the inside edge towards square leg for a run.
Short of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it to deep cover for a single.
A full ball, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it back past the diving fielder at extra cover for a couple of runs.
Good-length delivery, around off. Sophie Devine blocks it from the crease.
Back of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates steers it to third man and rotates the strike.
Full ball, outside off. Sophie Devine reaches out and defends it towards point.
On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine looks to push it through cover but it goes off the inside half of the blade towards cover.
Fuller in length, outside off. Sophie Devine drives it to the fielder at mid off.
A length ball, angling in from middle. Sophie Devine defends it solidly.
Back of a length, outside off. Sophie Devine cuts it but finds the backward point fielder.
Good-length delivery, around off. Sophie Devine blocks it to the off side.
Chinelle Henry to bowl from the other end.
Short of a length, outside off. Suzie Bates mistimes his cut shot towards cover-point. 4 runs off the first over!
Full and outside off. Sophie Devine drives it to deep cover and takes a single.
On a length, outside off. Sophie Devine flashes hard at it but fails to connect.
Back of a length, way outside off. Sophie Devine leaves it alone but the umpire doesn't call it wide.
A low full toss, outside off. Suzie Bates pushes it to cover and takes a single.
Full and wide, outside off. Suzie Bates shuffles across to heave it on the leg side but she misses.
Wide! Another ball, way outside off. Suzie Bates fails to reach out and the umpire signals a wide. Free Hit to continue.
NO BALL! Shamilia Connell oversteps and New Zealand Women get a free hit! A full ball, way outside off. Suzie Bates lets it be.
